text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver working software quickly, get feedback, and improve continuously.
